cheng: Observing 95/99 tail spikes (30-120ms) during prefill->decode handoff when seq crosses the slab boundary (e.g. 512->513). Correlates with kernel re-selection + KV cache colds. Repro on canary.
aj: Which model/quant and can you paste a short perf snippet?
maria: :eyes: also is this mixed-length batching only?
cheng: Model: redwood-3b-q4. Slabs configured: 0-256, 257-512, 513-2048. Happens on mixed batches where some requests cross 512. Minimal repro attached below.

```
timestamp: 1959994301
model: redwood-3b-q4
batch_id: b-843
seq_len: 513
path: prefill -> decode
kernel_pick_before: attn_v1_256
kernel_pick_after: split_attn_v2_512plus
kv_hit: false
latency_ms: 112   # baseline for same workload normally ~18ms
```

sara: That smells like kernel shadowing + first-launch cost on the new kernel. Did autotune decide different kernels for prefill vs decode?
cheng: Yes — autotune keys use "seq_bucket" but handoff triggers recompute on decode side which chooses a decode-optimized kernel. The transition forces a sync load and some kernel init path that adds overhead. KV miss amplifies it.
diego: We have a hysteresis param but it's 0 by default. We tried setting it to 10 and saw partial improvement but not complete.

aj: Quick mitigation ideas:
- 1) Add hysteresis of N tokens (require >boundary+N to switch)
- 2) Async pre-warm kernel on prefill if predicted decode bucket != current
- 3) Proactive KV prefetch when prefill indicates longer decode will follow

maria: Also add telemetry: counters for handoff_kernel_reload, handoff_kv_miss, predicted_decode_bucket. Tag with hw_type and pool.
runtime-bot: Canary 1959990000 is serving 4% of traffic. Alert: tail_latency_95 for redwood-3b-q4 increased +32ms between 1959994200 and 1959994320.

sara: I'll open a small PR to wire hysteresis and the counters. Prefer to run hysteresis=8 tokens on canary first.
aj: I'll prototype async pre-warm logic: cheap non-blocking kernel init with guard to avoid thrash.
diego: Reminder: check GPU driver lazy-init — we saw ~70ms on first kernel load after eviction in last quarter. Might be overlapping symptom.
maria: Good call. Add metric kernel_first_launch_ms and kernel_init_count.

cheng: Proposed experiment:
- enable hysteresis=8 on canary for 24h
- add counters/traces for each handoff event
- opt-in async kernel pre-warm behind a feature flag
- compare p95/p99 and number of handoff_kernel_reload events

sara: fine by me. I'll kick off deploy and PR.
aj: will add pre-warm flag + state machine to avoid dupe pre-warm calls.
maria: I'll add dashboards for the new counters and an alert if handoff_kernel_reload > 0.5% of requests.

runtime-bot: Deploy 1959994325 to canary started by @sara. CI logs: https://ci.redwood/1959994325

cheng: Thanks everyone. I'll collect perf dumps and do a follow-up after 24h with p95/p99 deltas and traces. If canary stabilizes we'll roll to staging.
sara: :thumbsup:
aj: :eyes:
cheng: Filing quick notes/postmortem after the experiment. Will include kernel launch flamegraphs and KV hit patterns.
